transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we have an urgent order for two laser-cut housing variants, H-22 and H-31, that must be completed this week. Cell 4 is idle and ready to go, and Cell 5 can be freed up after its current batch. Before I finalize the production plan and decide how to assign these variants across the two cells, I'd like to hear from each of you per our standard campaign-review routine. Quality, logistics, and maintenance — please report your findings so we can move quickly on this.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical quality requirement before we finalize the plan. The customer-approved drawing revision requires 24 first-off units across the H-22 and H-31 campaign to receive 100% dimensional inspection before release. I confirmed this in the customer quality portal yesterday, but the revised requirement has not yet been attached to the campaign traveler. We need to account for this inspection time and ensure the traveler is updated before production begins.

Cell 4 already has the compatible 0.8 mm nozzle installed for both H-22 and H-31 variants, but we must complete exactly 120 minutes of optical warm-up and alignment before any cutting can begin.
